atlas.name: The Atlas of Structures
atlas.truth: The world is not one model but the interplay of a few irreducible structures — graph, field, process, grammar, scale — and the transitions between them are where understanding lives.
atlas.description: Cross-cutting atlas. One walkable gallery collecting the thirteen meta-structures used across the spine curriculum, with transition zones between them showing how any two structures translate. Referenced from every sequence; not a progression itself.
learning_objectives: Recognize the thirteen meta-structures that recur across domains
Read a transition as a named verb bridging two structures
Place any algorithm, body, or system as an instance of (or hybrid between) these structures
